column3: “Thunder-clouds” is rendered “storm clouds,” and “rain of rain” “showers of rain”; NASB adds “who” and “And He will.”
“Wickedness” is rendered “iniquity,” “falsehood” “lying visions,” and “dreams of worthlessness” “false dreams”; NASB supplies “the people” and renders “set out” as “wander.”
“The leaders” is rendered “the male goats” (the Hebrew word); “visit” is rendered “punish” and “visited,” and “horse of his majesty” “His majestic horse.”
“A corner” is rendered “the cornerstone,” and “bow of war” “bow of battle”; NASB adds “all of them.”
“Warriors” is rendered “mighty men”; NASB supplies “the enemy,” and renders the active “put to shame” as passive.
“Make strong” is rendered “strengthen,” and “restore” “bring them back.”
“Warrior” is rendered “mighty man”; NASB adds “as if from,” “Indeed,” and “it.”
NASB renders “and I will gather them” as “to gather them together,” and “they will multiply as they multiplied” as “they will be as numerous as they were before.”
“And I will sow them” is rendered “When I scatter them,” and “distant places” “far countries.”
“Not it will be found for them” is rendered “Until no room can be found for them,” supplying “room.”
“The sea, trouble” is rendered “the sea of distress,” and “the River” “the Nile.”
